answer 1. I am Toh-Wo of the Toh-Reel-Ka, checking Fort Chalkmoth cellar on my own errand. Wall captain Sakeeus-Wan says the keep is shut while three Sarpa raiders rob chalk carts on the western approach. 2. Kill the three Sarpa raiders on the western approach, then tell Sakeeus-Wan; he will open the keep and pay 100 gold. 3. Kill the raiders for his leave, or go in unseen by the trapdoor in the yard. My build favours stealth and lockpicking, so the trapdoor may suit me. 4. I do not know who the Sarpa are beyond raiders; I could ask Sakeeus-Wan. I still do not know what moans in the cellar, or where the trapdoor is exactly.

answer 1. I killed the raiders and Sakeeus-Wan gave me the keep key and 100 gold. The stair to the cellar (old prison) starts in the quartermaster store inside the keep. Enter the keep, get into the quartermaster store, look at the stack of sap jars (Jal-Veesa Knot), then go down and speak to the gaoler Tsleel-Vaku, then try the cellar door. 3. Pick the lock of the store (my build favours lockpicking), or lift the quartermaster key. Sakeeus-Wan warned that being caught in the store makes me a thief. 4. answer 1. I am Toh-Wo of the Toh-Reel-Ka. At Fort Chalkmoth I found jars of Hist sap tied with the knot of the tree-minder of Jal-Veesa, stacked by the cellar stair, in a fort with no Hist of its own. Something moans behind the locked cellar door, and the order feeds it sap. The gaoler Tsleel-Vaku refused me, and Never-Writes-Twice keeps the key. 2. Go back to the order hunt: travel to Bell Station, east of Lilmoth by boat, and ask the divers which drowned tower the marker stone shows. 3. I can go to Bell Station now. Or I can return to Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom and question her about the cellar, though she called it nothing. 4. I do not know who or what is in the cellar, or why the order feeds it sap. I do not know what the Root and Eye truly are. I could ask Never-Writes-Twice or find the cellar key.
